about.seo.title: About ILogic | Software Built with Clear Logic
about.seo.description: Meet ILogic: experience that began in Russia, digital solutions for Egypt and the Middle East, and support for developers bringing their software to market.
about.breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
about.hero.title: Behind every solution,
about.hero.text: We started as freelancers in Russia, learning from every project. Today, working from Egypt for businesses across the Middle East, we bring design and development together to save you time and make life easier for your customers.
about.hero.caption: Connecting experience with your needs.
about.story.title: Every project taught us what matters.
about.story.aside: Technology is our tool. But we always start with the people who will use it, and the work that could be simpler.
about.story.russia.label: Our beginnings in Russia
about.story.russia.title: Experience through hands-on work
about.story.russia.text: Our story began as freelancers in Russia. We worked on varied projects, including large projects for major companies, and learned how to turn business needs into technology that works in practice.
about.story.russia.note: We do not have permission to discuss or display some of that work, so we only share what we are allowed to publish.
about.story.region.label: Egypt & the Middle East
about.story.region.title: Needs we knew we could help with
about.story.region.text: We saw businesses across the Middle East with room to grow, while their owners were absorbed in administration, follow-ups and tasks repeated every day. We found our role in building tools that ease that burden.
about.story.quote: When management takes up your whole day, when do you get to develop your business?
about.story.answer: That question led us to automate repetitive work and give business owners time to focus on what matters most.
about.services.title: Technology starts with your needs
about.services.text: You may need customers to find you, an easier way to buy, or a more organized business. We choose the solution around the problem you want to solve.
about.services.web.title: Websites & online stores
about.services.web.text: We present your business clearly and make it easier for customers to understand your services or complete a purchase.
about.services.seo.title: Search engine visibility
about.services.seo.text: We prepare your website and content for people searching for your services, with information that helps them make a decision.
about.services.systems.title: Business management systems
about.services.systems.text: We develop ERP, CRM and custom solutions to organize your data and customer relationships.
about.services.automation.title: Repetitive task automation
about.services.automation.text: We connect workflows and reduce manual follow-ups so your team can spend time on work that needs their expertise.
about.product.title: Building a system for business owners' peace of mind
about.product.text: We are developing a system to ease administrative burdens and repetitive responsibilities, giving owners room to think and grow. We are starting with small businesses' needs and developing it to extend to larger institutions.
about.product.interest: We have presented the system to major institutions that are waiting for its launch. Development continues, and we will share the details when it is ready.
about.product.focus: Your time matters for your business to grow
about.product.sceneLabel: The idea we are working towards
about.product.contact: Talk to us about your needs
about.innovators.title: Good software deserves a path to market
about.innovators.text: Every promising system has room to grow. We bring development, marketing and sales expertise to help its creators add new capabilities and reach the people who need it.
about.innovators.program: Through the ILogic Partners Program, we review each system with its creator and identify where our team can contribute. We collaborate on new features and a better user experience, alongside marketing, sales and support, with the scope and launch approach agreed together.
about.principles.title: Logic in every decision
about.principles.understand.title: Understand before proposing
about.principles.understand.text: We ask how your business works, where time is being lost, and what your customers actually need.
about.principles.purpose.title: Build around a clear purpose
about.principles.purpose.text: We connect each technical choice to a practical benefit for you or your customers, and look for steps we can simplify.
about.principles.team.title: Bring disciplines together
about.principles.team.text: Our multidisciplinary team brings together design, development, search engine optimization and automation.
about.principles.closing: We build every system with clear logic: every page has a purpose, every step has a reason, to save your time and make buying easier for your customers.
about.cta.title: What takes up your time today?
about.cta.text: Tell us about your business and what slows your day down, so we can understand where technology can help.
